Priya (People Ops): Thanks for staying after the all-hands — putting hiring/org follow-ups here. Keep questions short and we’ll reply. :spiral_note_pad:
Alex (CEO): Quick context: +18 hires approved across Q2/Q3. Main goals: speed up runtime innovation, shore up Dedicated SLAs, and add product leadership for Optimize.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Can we get the team-level targets? Slides were condensed.
Alex (CEO): Rough targets: 7 runtime, 5 eng-sre/platform, 3 product (2 PM, 1 PMM), 3 infra/security. Numbers are flexible based on candidate market.
Zara (Recruiting): We’ll post reqs tonight. Internal referrals fast-track — DM me resume + 2-line note.
Maya (Product): Are any of the PM roles scoped for Optimize vs Dedicated?
Priya (People Ops): Two senior PMs — one for Optimize, one split between Dedicated roadmap and Console integrations. JD links by EOD.
Ken (Finance): Reminder: this hires plan assumes baseline ARR trajectory. material booking shortfalls = hiring review.
Jordan (Eng Manager): What about TL/promotions vs external hires for runtime?
Priya (People Ops): Expect a blend: we aim to promote 1-2 internal TLs where readiness exists and hire senior IC/TL externally for immediate architecture work.
Ops Bot: Headcount tracker updated: https://internal.redwood/sheets/hc-plan-2177504444 (read: org, edit: hiring-managers).
Maya (Product): Any immediate org changes?
Alex (CEO): Minor structure tweak: creating a Runtime Platform lead to centralize infra-level decisions; no mass moves. Individual managers will be notified before any reporting changes.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Oncall ramp — when are new hires expected to carry rotation?
Priya (People Ops): Ramp guidance: 6-8 weeks to shadow oncall, 3 months for full rotation. we’ll fund pairing and temporary contractor coverage.
Ken (Finance): Short-term mitigation: contractor budget + oncall stipends while hires ramp.
Priya (People Ops): Action items: 1) JDs tonight, 2) internal transfer window opens when reqs post, 3) interview calibration session next week. Post follow-ups here and we’ll keep the thread open until org chart + JDs are live. :white_check_mark:
